properties.name: frontend.url
properties.description: Frontend application URL used for CORS allowed-origins and OAuth2 redirect configuration.

properties.name: backend.url
properties.description: Backend base URL used for generating self-referencing links and OAuth2 callback URLs.

properties.name: oauth.google.client-id
properties.description: Google OAuth2 client ID from Google Cloud Console (APIs & Services → Credentials).

properties.name: oauth.facebook.app-id
properties.description: Facebook OAuth2 app ID from Meta Developer Console.

properties.name: oauth.facebook.app-secret
properties.description: Facebook OAuth2 app secret used for token debug endpoint verification.

properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Base64-encoded secret key used to sign and verify JWT tokens. Must match across all services.

properties.name: jwt.expiration
properties.description: JWT token expiration duration in milliseconds. Default is 30 days (2592000000).

properties.name: rate-limit.requests-per-minute
properties.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per minute per client before rate limiting kicks in.

properties.name: email.support
properties.description: Support email address used as the sender for outgoing application emails.

properties.name: profile-views.max-history-size
properties.description: Maximum number of profile view history entries to retain per user.

properties.name: app.api-key
properties.description: Shared secret API key required on the X-API-Key header to access protected public endpoints (e.g. /profile/public/directory). Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. Set via the API_KEY environment variable in production — never commit the real value.

properties.name: spring.cloud.discovery.enabled
properties.description: Disables Spring Cloud service discovery (Eureka/Consul). Set to false when running without a service registry.

values.description: Suppresses hostname resolution warnings from Spring Cloud.
